statement_blocker: The catalog does not choose a definition/construction claim, minimum-distance theorem, maximum-likelihood error theorem, random-code comparison, iterative-decoding bound, decoder-complexity theorem, or later threshold/capacity result. It omits the code or ensemble, alphabet, parity-check degree and rank conventions, probability space, channel and decoder, rate and asymptotic regime, quantifier order, exact conclusion, proved-versus-hypothesized boundary, and degenerate cases needed for any one proposition.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix the alphabet/field, finite word and parity-check index types, deterministic code or probability ensemble, matrix/Tanner-graph quotient convention, channel and decoder if present, asymptotic parameter family, and all universe and typeclass data.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not say whether to prove a construction property, minimum-distance bound, maximum-likelihood performance theorem, iterative-decoding bound, complexity result, later threshold/capacity theorem, or another LDPC proposition.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every algebraic, degree, rank, graph, channel, decoder, probability, rate, asymptotic, endpoint, and computation boundary in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: the regular binary (n,j,k) low-density parity-check ensemble and its nominal rate

column degrees zero through four, k less than or equal to j, duplicate checks, rank deficiency, disconnected Tanner graphs, and multiple edges

noiseless and maximally noisy channel endpoints, decoding ties, nontermination, update scheduling, and finite versus unbounded iterations
ensemble average, existence, typical, and high-probability quantifiers and all fixed-versus-varying asymptotic parameters
proved theorems versus Gallager's stronger decoding hypothesis and experimental observations
